{{Quote|I assure you, it's not impossible. The bombardment of Lexus Nine created a rift beneath the surface that caused unprecedented cataclysms. Everyone died.|Fez Burba|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''bombardment of Lexus Nine''' was an event that saw the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lexus Nine]] undergo an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]]. It created a rift under the planet's surface that caused massive cataclysms and wiped out the entire population.
